new_hypothesis.name: boosts_top_feed_breakout
new_hypothesis.mechanism: DexScreener 'top'-tier paid promotional boosts act as a liquidity-and-intent filter: projects that buy into the 'top' tier (vs the cheaper 'latest' feed) self-select for higher capital and broader marketing reach. Boost spend creates a short attention window (6-24h) where retail discovery flows into the token via the trending pages, producing a pump tail. Filtering the feed by liquidity > $50k removes the rug-tier majority and keeps the projects with genuine market depth.
new_hypothesis.persistence: DexScreener 'top' boosts cost real $ and most degens never look at the boosts feed (they look at trending or pump.fun directly), so the audience reading boosts is small. Boosts are also a TimedAttentionEvent — only fresh boosts get traffic, so the window is naturally brief and not arbitraged by HFT. The bot already has the boosts poller live (sol_dex_boosts_log.json, run-266 onward) so infrastructure cost is zero.
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: TRIGGER: new boost entry in sol_dex_boosts_log.json with source=='top' AND age < 90 min. GATE: DexScreener pulls liquidity.usd > $50k AND fdv < $50M AND priceChange.h6 > -10% (not already dumping) AND priceChange.h24 > -30% (not already rugged) AND existing security gate passes (RugCheck+GoPlus). SIZE: 2% of bankroll (sub-baseline 3% because new strategy). TAKE: trailing stop activated +10%, hard stop -8% (default risk).
new_hypothesis.data_required: sol_dex_boosts_log.json (already collecting). DexScreener token endpoint (already used). No new infrastructure.
new_hypothesis.evidence: Sample of 38 boosted Solana mints (>6h after boost) split source='top' n=18 vs source='latest' n=20. 'top' median h24=-12.1%, median liq $70.6k, rug rate 44%, 22% big-winners (>+50%): CWU +227% liq $904k, GMAR +174% liq $157k, AMERICA +112% liq $73k, FAAV (in top 5), GME-Sol. 'latest' median h24=-28.3%, median liq $7.4k, rug rate 75%. Watchlist overlap: only GME, MAGA, HANTA appeared in 500 boost entries — UNOS, USDPT, YEP, IMOUT, $AI absent → boost feed is independent of bot's existing channels.

proposals_for_survival_brain.justification: Independent from existing strategies; live sample n=18 'top' boosts shows 22% big-winner rate (>+50% h24) at 44% rug rate vs 75% on 'latest'. Liquidity > $50k filter eliminates the worst sub-tier. Boosts poller already running, zero infra cost.
proposals_for_survival_brain.baseline: No current 'boosts'-driven strategy exists. Closest analogue: voldiv_v2 (volume-divergence, all_time N=50 WR=42% RR=0.62 pnl=-0.0589 SOL) and fresh_profile (all_time N=15 WR=60% RR=1.17 pnl=+0.0029 SOL, currently inactive). Direct analog in research sample: 'top'-feed boost mints n=18 median h24=-12.1%, big-winner rate 22%, rug rate 44%.
proposals_for_survival_brain.expected_effect: Paper-trial WR 30-40%, RR 1.5+ (target+trailing tail dominates median return), 4 fires/day, +0.0010 SOL/day net if 22% big-winner rate holds and stops cap downside. Worst-case net -0.0008 SOL/day.
proposals_for_survival_brain.kill_criteria: Rolling 20-trade WR < 30% OR rolling 20-trade RR < 0.80 OR rolling 20-trade pnl_sol < -0.005 SOL → kill strategy. Big-winner rate (h24 > +50% in any held trade) < 15% by N=20 → kill.
proposals_for_survival_brain.min_sample_size: N=20 paper-trade fires before any size increase. Real-money trial only after paper N=20 with WR>=35%.
proposals_for_survival_brain.regime_scope: ANY (boost-driven, not regime-correlated). Initial trial CHOP-only (current regime) to constrain risk.
proposals_for_survival_brain.rollback_plan: Disable boosts_top_feed_breakout strategy in degen_bot.py STRATEGY_REGISTRY; boosts poller continues for future research.
proposals_for_survival_brain.risk_if_wrong: Adds ~4 stops/day at -8% on 2% positions = -0.0064 SOL/day for ≤5 days before kill_criteria trip = ~-0.032 SOL absolute downside (~3% of bankroll). Capped because 2% size and tight rolling kill. Far less than copy_trade has been losing.

proposals_for_survival_brain.expected_effect: Reduce stop-loss count by ~10-15% (back-of-envelope: 51% recidivism × 73 trades = 37 losses avoidable; if extrapolated to full log ~280 lifetime same-deployer losses, blacklist could prevent ~10% of total stops). Predicted: stop_loss_rate 50.6% → 46-48%, all_time WR 35.5% → ~37-38%, all_time pnl improves by ~+0.10 SOL over the next 200 trades.
proposals_for_survival_brain.kill_criteria: Rolling 50-trade post-deploy: false-positive rate (deployer-blacklisted mint that would have won) > 30% → loosen filter or kill. Net SOL change after N=50 < +0.005 SOL → kill. Implementation bug indicator: blacklist file blows past 200 wallets in < 7d → review.
proposals_for_survival_brain.min_sample_size: N=50 post-implementation trades to evaluate, regime-stratified if possible. Soft check at N=20.
proposals_for_survival_brain.rollback_plan: Remove deployer-blacklist gate in _process_signal of degen_bot.py; clear sol_deployer_blacklist.json. Token-level cooldown retained.
proposals_for_survival_brain.risk_if_wrong: False-positive blacklist denies entries that would have won — at most 30-40% of new-deployer flow gated, but only if first trade was a loss. Net cost ≤ ~3 missed wins/week × +6% = -0.018 SOL/week opportunity cost, which is < the ~0.10 SOL stops avoided. Asymmetric upside.
proposals_for_survival_brain.implementation_hint: Resolve deployer wallet from token's first transaction signer (Alchemy getSignaturesForAddress oldest tx → signer[0]; the subagent already wrote mint_creators.json). Maintain sol_deployer_blacklist.json with {wallet: first_loss_timestamp}. Block any new buy if mint's deployer is in blacklist within last 7 days. proposals_for_survival_brain.justification: Research-111 hypothesis 'velocity_min<3 = -81% returns' is REFUTED by fresh n=30 stratified sample. Real signal is INVERTED: velocity_min > 30 min has 80% rug rate / -76.7% mean h24, while velocity_min < 3 has 50% rug / -50.9% mean h24 (still -EV but less bad). A defensive filter blacklisting graduations with velocity_min > 30 min is a small but clean risk reducer once any pump.fun grad strategy goes live.
proposals_for_survival_brain.baseline: No live pump.fun graduation entry strategy. velocity_min field is enriched and live in sol_pumpfun_graduation_log.json (142/142 backlog drained per run-266 status). Cross-link to forward returns is NEW data point this run.
proposals_for_survival_brain.expected_effect: If/when a graduation strategy is launched, gating to velocity_min < 30 min would remove 33% of candidates (10/30 in sample) at the cost of 33% of all rugs (8 of 23 rugs in sample were vmin>30). That's a clean 1:1 — but vmin>30 also contains the worst tail (-99%/-97% rugs), so removing them improves variance more than it improves median.
proposals_for_survival_brain.kill_criteria: If a graduation strategy gets implemented and the rolling 20-trade rug rate of vmin<30 candidates is NOT lower than vmin>30 in live data (allowing for n=30 noise) → drop the filter.
proposals_for_survival_brain.min_sample_size: N=60 graduation forward returns before promoting from defensive filter to entry signal.
proposals_for_survival_brain.regime_scope: ANY (graduation dynamics are not regime-specific in current data).
proposals_for_survival_brain.rollback_plan: Remove the vmin filter from graduation pipeline; revert to research-111 spec OR remove the strategy entirely if it had no entry signal beyond this filter.
proposals_for_survival_brain.risk_if_wrong: DEFENSIVE-ONLY filter — if wrong, costs ~33% of candidates we would've held off on, but those candidates were 80% rugs anyway. Negligible opportunity-cost downside. Save for next-time-grad-strategy-is-active; do NOT change anything live now.
